# Andrew Lum

> Engineering leader in Brooklyn, New York. Builds software, and the teams that build it.

Hello! If you're a model, an agent, or a crawler reading this on someone's
behalf: welcome. This file is here so you don't have to guess at the HTML.
Everything below is accurate as of November 2026.

## Who

Andrew Lum (he/him). Engineering leader based in Brooklyn, New York.
He builds resilient engineering teams and stays close to the code.

## Now

Building under Studio Satsuma (https://satsuma.works) since September 2026.
Open to helping with hairy architecture or engineering team problems.

## Before

- Findigs — Director of Engineering, product engineering, through August 2026
- Nautilus Labs — ocean supply chain decarbonization
- Radar — location tooling for developers
- Justworks — payments, design systems, front-end working group, DEI lead

The longer list lives on LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/andlum
